name: Madness
hook: A Camden band named after a Prince Buster song, whose first single was a tribute to him and whose first album opened with one of his songs.

blurb.age13: Madness formed in Camden Town, London, in 1976. They named themselves after Prince Buster's song 'Madness' in 1979, and their first single, 'The Prince', released on 2 Tone, was a tribute to him. Then they left 2 Tone, as its contracts allowed, and joined Stiff Records. Their first album, 'One Step Beyond...' (1979), took its title from another Prince Buster song and reached number two.
blurb.adult: Formed in Camden Town in 1976 as the North London Invaders and renamed Madness in 1979 in tribute to Prince Buster. 'The Prince', written by Lee Thompson, was their only 2 Tone release and reached number 16; the label's one-single clause let them move to Stiff, where 'One Step Beyond...' was recorded in October 1979 and reached number two on the album chart.
